title: fix(console): an app-root deep link keeps its query when it redirects to the landing page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7gczRvt4v7U6F1vGJkYJdM)_
Fixes #27450

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：打开 `/apps/APP?palette=1` 这类应用根深链时，应用根重定向到默认页会保留查询串和 hash，命令面板照常打开；`?recordId=`、`?form=` 等其它 URL 浮层参数同样保留。控制台根 `/?palette=1` 也一样。
- **为什么改**：应用根的重定向只用默认页地址拼目标，把查询串丢了，浮层参数在被读取之前就没了。分诊结论是「重定向要把查询带过去」。
- **风险与回滚**：只改两处前端重定向的目标拼接；不带查询的应用根行为字节不变。默认页自身带查询（页面 `params`、对象 `filters`/`runAction`）时两者合并，同名键以链接为准、不重复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的 `carryQueryOntoLanding` 与 `AppRootLanding` 里那行 `Navigate`；然后 `ui/apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx` 末尾的重定向；最后新测试 `AppContent.rootLandingCarriesQuery-27450.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.rootLandingCarriesQuery-27450.test.tsx apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 22 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two redirects that land a user on a page rebuilt their target without the URL's query, so the URL overlays (`?palette=1`, `?recordId=`, `?form=`, the constants in `urlParams.ts`) were dropped before `useUrlOverlay` read them.

- **App root** (`/apps/APP`, `AppRootLanding` in `AppContent.tsx`): the `Navigate` to the app's landing now goes through a new local helper, `carryQueryOntoLanding(landing, location.search, location.hash)`. With nothing arriving the target is unchanged. With no query on the landing the arriving search is appended as written. A landing can carry a query of its own (a `page` entry's `params`, an `object` entry's `filters` or `runAction`, built by `resolveHref`): then the two merge through `URLSearchParams`, and a key the arriving URL names replaces the landing's values for that key instead of doubling it (the link is the more specific ask). The arriving hash wins over a landing hash; `resolveHref` emits none today.
- **Console root** (`/`, `RootLandingRedirect` in `ui/apps/console`): the `RedirectWithSplash` target now appends `location.search` and `location.hash`. Its landing is a bare `/apps/SEGMENT` or `/home`, so there is nothing to merge; the app root it lands on carries the query on in turn.

The fix is generic query carriage, not a palette special case. The other redirects on these paths were measured and left as they are:

- Already carrying search and hash: the name-alias move to the package id (objectstack-ai/objectstack#26183 effect in `AppContent`), `LegacyMetadataRedirect` directory mode, `ShorthandRecordRedirect`, `SystemRedirect` and `SetupRedirect` in `ConsoleShell.tsx`.
- Left alone on purpose: the no-active-app bounce to `homePath` in `AppContent` (`RedirectWithSplash to={homePath}`). It is a refusal, not a landing on the requested page, and a record-overlay param there would address an app the caller cannot open. `LegacyMetadataRedirect` resource mode deliberately consumes its `?type=` into the path; unchanged. `metadata/package/*` forwards to a fixed packages page; unchanged.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.rootLandingCarriesQuery-27450.test.tsx`, on the `AppContent.nameAliasRedirect-26183` harness (a real `AppContent` mount; the router's location is the observation point). Its `ConsoleLayout` stand-in keeps the real `CommandPaletteProvider` the shipped layout mounts, so "the palette is open" is that provider's own answer from the landed URL. Cases: the card's URL (`/apps/showcase_app?palette=1`, through the name-alias move too) lands on the default page with `?palette=1` kept, `REPLACE`, palette open; a record-drawer param and a hash are carried; a landing with its own `?runAction=` merges with `?palette=1`; a key both name is the link's value once; CONTROL: a bare app root lands bare with the palette closed.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx`: three cases added (default app with query and hash, the launcher with query, CONTROL bare `/`), and its location probe now also renders the hash.

Ablation, each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):

- `AppContent.tsx` target reverted to `to={landing}`: 4 of 5 new cases red, the CONTROL green.
- `RootLandingRedirect.tsx` target reverted to `to={landing}`: the 2 new carrying cases red, the other 15 in the file green.

## Acceptance notes

- `/home?palette=1` from the console root keeps the query, but the home frame mounts no `CommandPaletteProvider` (`useCommandPalette` documents the home and orgs frames as palette-less), so the palette does not open there. The card names the app root; this is noted, not changed.
- An unauthenticated `/?palette=1` goes to login first; whether `LoginRedirect` captures a bare `/` with a query is outside this card and unchanged.
- Browser reproduction of the card's steps on a running showcase was not done in this container; the acceptance is pinned by the mounted `AppContent` test above.
